en: Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
zh: 变更 `--bare`：现在只连接命令行中指定的 MCP 服务器，不向模型发送系统提醒，也不启动后台任务；在 `--bare` 下，shell 命令达到超时后会停止，而不再转入后台
